name: Shemaiah
bio: Shemaiah was a man of God through whom the word of the LORD came to Rehoboam, king of Judah, when Rehoboam had mustered 180,000 fighting men from Judah and Benjamin to force the ten rebelling tribes back under his rule. Shemaiah told Rehoboam and all Judah not to fight against their fellow Israelites, since the division of the kingdom was the LORD's own doing; Rehoboam and his army obeyed and turned back home (1 Kings 12:21-24).
